subtasks.decision: One owned objective decomposes into local subtasks; subtasks are not durable claimable jobs.
Local subtask carries id/question/result/verification; authority remains bundle-level.
Four local checkpoints follow groups of >=3 subtasks and perform no GitHub I/O.
Packet stays bounded to exact work/source/mission/DoD/evidence/capabilities/non-goals plus authority ref.
Budget I/O by phase; forbid per-subtask repo writes while preserving mandatory runtime writes.
Separate local compute, external I/O and external wait; model duration is not wall-clock evidence.
Map each DoD row to exact check/evidence; local completion alone is not PASS.
Persist one aggregate bundle with decisions, checkpoint defects, audit defects, I/O status and next action.
Use PASS/FAIL/BOUNDARY; capability/authority/transport limits remain explicit non-PASS boundaries.
After counted RETURN, re-enter existing compact allocator with same worker_id; no new scheduler.
Compare only against matched SINGLE_PASS on observable metrics; no self-declared winner.
Change no CURRENT/binding; preserve identity/claim/residency and create no durable row per local subtask.
